en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couplets on the Root and Having-a-Root (Hetusahetukaduka)

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, both a cause and accompanied by a cause, there arises a state that is not non-demonstrable, not non-reactive, neither a cause nor accompanied by a cause, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, accompanied by a cause, and not itself a cause...

A state that is both rootless and not without a root arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for the root [condition] … pe … three [answers] for the non-disappearance [condition].
